deck: 8月11日SEC文件确认SpaceX以600亿美元全股票交易收购Cursor开发者Anysphere，Cursor正准备以500亿估值融资20亿却被SpaceX截胡。25岁CEO Truell的公司成为AI编程史上最大并购，Grok代码能力+Cursor入口+SpaceX算力，马斯克的AI版图完成最关键拼图。
deck_en: On August 11, SEC filings confirmed SpaceX will acquire Cursor developer Anysphere for $60B in an all-stock deal. Cursor was poised to raise $2B at $50B valuation from a16z and Nvidia — SpaceX intercepted. The 25-year-old CEO Truell's company becomes the largest M&A in AI coding history; with Grok code capability plus Cursor access plus SpaceX compute, Musk completes his most critical AI board puzzle.
